searchText: Thanks, allocating more resources worked! However, running with L33-L35 uncommented works with Lodestar but not with Teku (even in a Teku-only setting). Not sure if this is machine issue because I've used max resources. Could you try running with L33-L35 included? Actually both run fine on my side, the screenshot I shared was with L33-L35 uncommented and I also tried again Awesome, thanks for confirming! Can we launch focil-devnet-0? We have 2 CLs and 3 CLs ready and [this config](https://github.com/jihoonsong/local-devnet-focil/blob/main/kurtosis/kurtosis.config.registry.interop.yaml) worked well. cc <@577788234810130432> <@199561711278227457> I've also updated the [spec sheet for focil-devnet-0](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/focil-devnet-0). Didn't touch the config section though, but I'd want to have some blob transactions spammed to see it doesn't break anything. https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1544384523003887678/1552694263865937920 Forwarding here for visibility, I believe we're ready to launch focil-devnet-0 with 2 CLs and 3 ELs. i won't get around to it this week, but will look into it for next
